title: Standalone VIXEN GPU harness needs copied CTest Vulkan environment
body: The baseline invocation `python3 VIXEN/tools/multiinstance_cache_gate.py --mode baseline --app build/binaries/VIXEN --editor build/binaries/vixen_editor --document VIXEN/BuiltAssets/documents/sample_tri_layer.vxd --work-dir build/runtime-captures/multiinstance` launched its first app without CTest Vulkan loader variables; the warm-app log recorded VK_ERROR_INCOMPATIBLE_DRIVER. Recovery copied VK_ICD_FILENAMES, VK_LAYER_PATH, and LD_LIBRARY_PATH from the generated CTest environment before rerunning. Expose a reusable environment helper so standalone GPU harnesses inherit the supported Vulkan setup.

title: Silent native CTest witness trips box queue idle watchdog
body: The documented native capture command `env -u DISPLAY -u WAYLAND_DISPLAY -u VK_ICD_FILENAMES -u VK_LAYER_PATH -u LD_LIBRARY_PATH bash /home/liory/.local/bin/with-test-lock.sh --agent codex-multiinstance --resource test --label multiinstance:native-capture-witness -- ctest --test-dir build -R ^vixen_wsl_capture_witness$ --output-on-failure` emitted only CTest start output while a 180-second child ran; the global wrapper killed it at 200 seconds as STALL_KILLED with payload_exit=141 before the editor phase result. Recovery keeps the same queued CTest command but runs it under a shell loop that prints a heartbeat every 30 seconds. Add a queue-supported heartbeat/streaming option for long quiet CTest children so valid witnesses are not killed as idle.

title: Native WSL capture witness timeout is shorter than sequential app runs
body: The first queued native witness command (ctest --test-dir build -R '^vixen_wsl_capture_witness$' --output-on-failure) exited 8 at CTest TIMEOUT 300.11s while the editor was still advancing captures and had produced frames 5, 45, 75, and 105. The script also capped each child at timeout 180s. I raised each child cap to 300s and the combined CTest budget to 600s, then reran the same witness. Derive the capture timeout from measured WSL frame throughput or make a clear per-platform budget so valid slow captures do not fail at the suite boundary.

title: Editor capture fixture timeout is shorter than WSL DZN capture duration
body: The queued CTest command ctest --test-dir build -L 'RenderGraph|SVO' --output-on-failure -j 4 failed CTest #2912 vixen_editor_capture_producer at TIMEOUT 181.34s. Its build/runtime-captures/editor/run_editor_script.log had advanced through capture tick 75, so the fixture was progressing but had not reached captures 105/115 or exit frame 140. I raised this producer CTest TIMEOUT from 180s to 360s; rerun the same suite after reconfigure. Derive a platform-specific capture budget from measured WSL frame throughput so required editor fixtures can finish.
